# `/ai-access-request-recommendations` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /ai-access-request-recommendations/v1

`getAccessRequestRecommendationsV1` — Identity access request recommendations — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns the access request recommendations for the specified identity. The default identity is *me* which indicates the current user.

- Scopes: iai:access-request-recommender:manage, iai:access-request-recommender:read
- User levels: Any
- Parameters:
  - `identity-id` (query) — default me — Get access request recommendations for an identityId. *me* indicates the current user.
  - `limit` (query) — max 15 — default 15 — Max number of results to return.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `include-translation-messages` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate a list of translation messages in the response.
  - `filters` (query) — fields: access.name: co; access.type: eq, in; access.description: co, eq, in — e.g. `access.name co "admin"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: access.name, access.type By default the recommendations are sorted by highest confidence first. — e.g. `access.name`
- Returns 200: array of accessrequestrecommendationitemdetail

### GET /ai-access-request-recommendations/v1/config

`getAccessRequestRecommendationsConfigV1` — Get access request recommendations config — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns the configurations for Access Request Recommender for the tenant.

- Scopes: iai:configuration:manage, iai:configuration:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Returns 200: accessrequestrecommendationconfigdto

### PUT /ai-access-request-recommendations/v1/config

`setAccessRequestRecommendationsConfigV1` — Update access request recommendations config — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API updates the configurations for Access Request Recommender for the tenant.

- Scopes: iai:configuration:manage, iai:configuration:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): accessrequestrecommendationconfigdto
- Returns 200: accessrequestrecommendationconfigdto

### POST /ai-access-request-recommendations/v1/ignored-items

`addAccessRequestRecommendationsIgnoredItemV1` — Ignore access request recommendation — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API ignores a recommended access request item. Once an item is ignored, it will be marked as ignored=true if it is still a recommended item. The consumer can decide to hide ignored recommendations.

- Scopes: iai:access-request-recommender:manage, idn:access-request:manage
- User levels: Any
- Body (application/json): accessrequestrecommendationactionitemdto
- Returns 201: accessrequestrecommendationactionitemresponsedto

### GET /ai-access-request-recommendations/v1/ignored-items

`getAccessRequestRecommendationsIgnoredItemsV1` — List ignored access request recommendations — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns the list of ignored access request recommendations.

- Scopes: iai:access-request-recommender:manage, idn:access-request:manage
- User levels: Any
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: access.id: eq, in; access.type: eq, in; identityId: eq, in — e.g. `identityId eq "2c9180846b0a0583016b299f210c1314"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: access.id, access.type, identityId, timestamp — e.g. `access.id`
- Returns 200: array of accessrequestrecommendationactionitemresponsedto

### POST /ai-access-request-recommendations/v1/requested-items

`addAccessRequestRecommendationsRequestedItemV1` — Accept access request recommendation — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API consumes a notification that a recommended access request item was requested. This API does not actually make the request, it is just a notification. This will help provide feedback in order to improve our recommendations.

- Scopes: iai:access-request-recommender:manage, idn:access-request:manage
- User levels: Any
- Body (application/json): accessrequestrecommendationactionitemdto
- Returns 201: accessrequestrecommendationactionitemresponsedto

### POST /ai-access-request-recommendations/v1/viewed-items

`addAccessRequestRecommendationsViewedItemV1` — Mark viewed access request recommendations — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API consumes a notification that a recommended access request item was viewed. Future recommendations with this item will be marked with viewed=true. This can be useful for the consumer to determine if there are any new/unviewed recommendations.

- Scopes: iai:access-request-recommender:manage
- User levels: Any
- Body (application/json): accessrequestrecommendationactionitemdto
- Returns 201: accessrequestrecommendationactionitemresponsedto

### POST /ai-access-request-recommendations/v1/viewed-items/bulk-create

`addAccessRequestRecommendationsViewedItemsV1` — Bulk mark viewed access request recommendations — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**
